panels.title: Avg execution time per widget: base vs aggregate
panels.description: Average query time (ms) for each dashboard widget, base fact scan vs pre-aggregate.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT widget,
       round(avg(duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE query_name LIKE '%\_base' AND query_name NOT LIKE '%month\_base'),2) AS base_ms,
       round(avg(duration_ms) FILTER (WHERE query_name LIKE '%\_agg'),2)  AS agg_ms
FROM meta.query_log
WHERE status='SUCCESS'
  AND (query_name LIKE '%\_agg' OR (query_name LIKE '%\_base' AND query_name NOT LIKE '%month\_base'))
  AND $__timeFilter(executed_at)
GROUP BY widget ORDER BY widget;

panels.title: Queries today
panels.description: Number of query executions logged so far today.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) AS queries_today
FROM meta.query_log WHERE executed_at::date = current_date;

panels.title: Query error rate
panels.description: Failed queries ÷ total queries × 100 in the selected range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT round(100.0*count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='FAILED')/nullif(count(*),0),2) AS error_rate_pct
FROM meta.query_log WHERE $__timeFilter(executed_at);

panels.title: Single-month q1: DuckDB table vs Parquet partition (partition = storage/access benefit, NOT a speed-up)
panels.description: Same one-month channel-margin query. On this WSL/DrvFS setup the Parquet partition is slower than the indexed table; its value is storage (~10 MB of monthly Parquet vs the ~61 MB database) and reading one month without opening the DB. Do not read the partition row as a regression.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT CASE query_name
         WHEN 'q1_channel_margin_month_base' THEN 'DuckDB table (indexed)'
         WHEN 'q1_channel_margin_partitioned' THEN 'Parquet partition (storage/access, not faster)'
       END AS access_path,
       round(avg(duration_ms)::numeric,2) AS avg_ms, count(*) AS runs
FROM meta.query_log
WHERE query_name IN ('q1_channel_margin_month_base','q1_channel_margin_partitioned')
  AND status='SUCCESS'
GROUP BY query_name ORDER BY avg_ms;
